description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 987 - Order to direct that a duty of Rs. 30/- pre Litre  to be levied on bottled toddy w.e.f. 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the issuance of a new excise regulation (Excise Notification No. 987) under the Excise Ordinance, which establishes a duty rate on bottled toddy and rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the creation of a new fiscal rule under existing legal authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
